MESSAGE:
Dear Globex Logistics Team,

Thank you for your email regarding the renewal of our warehousing contract with a proposed 5% increase effective from 1 December 2026.

We take all contract renewals seriously and want to ensure that any pricing adjustment is properly grounded in the terms of our existing agreement, our internal pricing/escalation policies, and your recent service level performance, including any credits that may be due to us. At this time, we are unable to locate the current warehousing contract, its renewal and pricing clauses, our applicable escalation policy, or recent SLA performance records on our side.

Before we can confirm, counter, or otherwise respond substantively to the proposed 5% increase, we need to complete an internal review of these documents. We would be grateful if you could, in the meantime, send us a copy of the current contract and any relevant SLA or performance reports you hold on file, as this will help expedite our review.

We will follow up with a full response, including confirmation of terms or any counter-proposal, as soon as our internal review is complete. We appreciate your patience in the interim.

Kind regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement

INTERNAL NOTE:
We have no retrievable records for the Globex Logistics warehousing contract — no current terms, pricing, expiry date, renewal/escalation clauses, SLA performance data, or outstanding credits. Only documentation on file relates to the Acme Cloud Services hosting contract
